findings.title: Comparator extraction is labelled absent despite recorded, source-backed values
findings.page_quote: <dt>k</dt><dd>NOT EXTRACTED from held text</dd><dt>effect</dt><dd>NOT EXTRACTED from held text</dd><dt>ci</dt><dd>NOT EXTRACTED from held text</dd>

evidence.quote: osite (kidney failure, a sustained decrease of at least 40% in the eGFR from baseline, or death from renal causes) [HR: 0.84, 95% CI 0.77-0.92, 2 : 0, I 2 : 0%). Finerenone was also associated with reduction in UACR (SMD: -0.49, 95% CI -0.53 to
Comparator text says only two citations reported the conforming renal composite; those are FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD, matching this pool.

findings.why: The comparator object records the renal-composite estimate, CI, two-trial membership and matching overlap, with located source spans. Empty comparator_panel fields are presented as absence of extraction across the review.
findings.fix: Render the source-backed comparator fields, or explicitly identify the panel fields as unpopulated while acknowledging the extraction recorded elsewhere in review.json.

findings.title: Comparator enumeration statements contradict each other
findings.page_quote: Trial set NOT ENUMERATED; overlap unknown.

evidence.quote: Registered comparator identity (adopted 2026-10-05, pre-registered selection rule 530da166a). Its trial set and pooled result are typed, with spans verified in held sources, in registry/comparator_selection/esketamine-trd-madrs.adoption.json and registry/comparator_enumerations/esketamine-trd-madrs.json.

findings.why: The same comparator panel says its trial set is typed and source-verified, then says it is not enumerated. An empty local panel list does not establish that no enumeration exists.
findings.fix: State that trial membership is not populated in this panel and point to the enumeration named by the recorded scope note.

findings.title: Suppressed incompatible trials are described as pooled
findings.page_quote: k = 2: the 2 trial(s) named below were pooled;

evidence.quote: pooled effect SUPPRESSED: the trials mix incompatible estimand classes (HAZARD_RATIO_FIRST_EVENT + INCIDENCE_RATE_RATIO) — these effect measures are not one quantity without an explicit, source-backed conversion, so no pooled effect, CI, heterogeneity or sensitivity is valid. The per-trial estimates are shown; pool each coherent strand separately.

findings.why: The membership sentence implies a valid synthesis despite the recorded suppression and the adjacent explanation that these trials are shown individually.
findings.fix: For suppressed outcomes, describe the rows as individual trial estimates and state that they were not pooled into a served result.
